ud3.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
ud3.10:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisinno hoti vimuttisukhapaṭisaṃvedī.
ud3.10:2.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi.
ud3.10:2.2: addasā kho bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte anekehi santāpehi santappamāne, anekehi ca pariḷāhehi pariḍayhamāne
ud3.10:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud3.10:6.1: ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavena bhavassa vippamokkhamāhaṃsu sabbe te avippamuttā bhavasmāti vadāmi.
ud3.10:6.2: ye vā pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vibhavena bhavassa nissaraṇamāhaṃsu sabbe te anissaṭā bhavasmāti vadāmi.
ud3.10:7.1: upadhiṃ paṭicca dukkhamidaṃ sambhoti sabbupādānakkhayā natthi dukkhassa sambhavo
ud3.10:7.3: puthū avijjāya paretā bhūtā bhūtaratā bhavā aparimuttā.
ud3.10:7.4: ye hi keci bhavā sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbe te bhavā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā.
ud3.10:10.4: sippaṃ lokena te dasāti. meghiyavaggo catuttho
